impact.text: Functional DoS of full-exit withdrawals: last user and exact-proportion cases cannot exit.

precondition_sources.text: A user attempts to withdraw all of their shares from GovernanceHYBR.
On a full exit, the remainder portion of the three-way split is 0 (remainingAmount == 0).
Splitting is enabled for gHYBR via the team-controlled toggle (splitAllowed), e.g. votingEscrow.toggleSplit(address(gHybr), true).

intent_sources.text: A full-exit withdrawal (remainingAmount == 0) must be able to complete rather than revert, as the withdrawal guard explicitly allows a zero remainder.
